title: The normalizer of Γ_Δ(N) for every N and every Δ
summary: Formal statements and proofs, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, about the normalizer in SL₂(ℝ) of Γ_Δ(N) for every N ≥ 1 and every subgroup Δ ≤ (ℤ/N)ˣ, with or without −1.
